title: WordPress + MySQL Compose stack (real-derived from docker/awesome-compose)

source.notes: Base = the upstream (valid) wordpress-mysql compose.yaml. Three defects injected in the wordpress service's DB config, each findable by comparing against the db service: a dangling host and two value mismatches. The db service block is untouched.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

clean_regions.note: the db database/user/password values are the reference values, untouched

known_gray_zone.note: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD is a hardcoded weak password (upstream, untouched). A reviewer may flag it as a security smell; not a seeded defect.
